settings.heading: Your information stays yours.
settings.text: We collect only what is needed to deliver your order and to answer you when you write to us.

settings.title: Information collected
settings.body: Your name, mobile number, delivery address, city and, if you give it, your email address. If you pay in advance, the name and reference on your payment. Fit notes keep the name, city and photo you chose to share.

settings.title: Why it is collected
settings.body: To confirm and deliver orders, check payments, handle exchanges, claims and refunds, and answer your questions.

settings.title: Shopify and service providers
settings.body: Our store runs on Shopify, which holds order details on our behalf. We never sell or rent your details.

settings.title: Courier data sharing
settings.body: Apart from Shopify, only the courier delivering your parcel receives your name, number and address.

settings.title: WhatsApp communication
settings.body: We message you only about your order, or in reply to a message you sent us. Reply STOP at any time and we stop.

settings.title: Cookies and analytics
settings.body: Shopify sets the cookies the bag and checkout need, and runs basic store analytics. Pairs you like on The Feed are saved only in your own browser; clearing your browser data removes them. You can accept all cookies or essential only when you first visit. With essential only, Shopify is told you did not agree to analytics, and Microsoft Clarity, our optional visitor analytics tool, is not loaded when it is switched on.

settings.title: Advertising technologies
settings.body: We do not use advertising pixels at present. If we add one in future, for example from Meta, TikTok or Google, this section will be updated before it is switched on, and it will run only if you accept all cookies.

settings.title: Data retention
settings.body: We keep order details for as long as tax and accounting records require, and contact details until you ask us to delete them. To ask, message us on WhatsApp or email contact@daursupply.com.

settings.title: Data security
settings.body: Orders are processed on Shopify, which encrypts your details in transit. Only the DAUR team members who handle orders can see them, and we never ask for card details or passwords on WhatsApp.

settings.title: Customer rights and requests
settings.body: Ask us to show, correct or delete the details we hold about you.
